title: Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia Testing Limits of Mecca Pact Obligations
detail: South China Morning Post analysis finds that continued Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia are testing the limits of the Mecca regional security pact, examining Saudi defensive posture and the extent of pact obligations. The analysis underscores growing pressure on member states to move beyond technical assistance toward active defense commitments as Houthi strikes continue.

title: Classified US Assessment: Saudi Arabia Has Not Ruled Out Nuclear Weapons Development
detail: A classified US intelligence assessment warns that Saudi Arabia has not ruled out developing nuclear weapons, according to reporting by Times of India. The assessment raises concerns about the kingdom's nuclear ambitions amid ongoing regional tensions and its civil nuclear program discussions with Washington. The finding adds a new dimension to the Mecca Defense Pact's strategic calculus, as Saudi Arabia's potential pursuit of nuclear capability would have profound implications for regional security architecture and US non-proliferation policy.

media.caption: Saudi Arabia has not ruled out developing nuclear weapons, a classified US intelligence assessment warns
